Every mod Rimrooms was built alongside, what each one is for, and what you lose by skipping it.

The mod list

Rimrooms was built alongside 296 mods and expansions. This page says what each one is for, and what changes if you leave it out.

The base game is listed too, for context. It is not counted in that 296.

Nothing here is required to launch

Rimrooms declares no mod as a hard dependency and starts on its own. Required below means required for the experience as it was built, never required to run.

Leave out anything tagged Optional and nothing breaks. Rimrooms falls back to what the base game already ships.

TagHow manyWhat it means
Required2The game itself.
Recommended83Built against this. Skipping it loses a part of the intended experience.
Optional192Works with it, works without it.
Visual only4Changes how things look and nothing else.
Not needed16Rimrooms does not interact with it at all.

Required (2)

ModWhat it does hereWithout itWatch for
CoreEverything. Every gate is one of Core's own doors, every cue falls back to a Core sound, and every object Rimrooms cannot supply is one Core already ships.This is the game itself.Rimrooms targets RimWorld 1.6.
Rimrooms - Async IndustriesThis is the mod this list is about.There is no list.Declares no hard dependency on anything below, and starts on its own.
